Pose00 / starting neutral: Retto sits tall but relaxed, all4 paws grounded, wings half-open and relaxed. Whole head/neck faces mostly front with a tiny friendly leftward inclination, eyes bright and small. Tato's hands relaxed near belly, head turned toward Retto; Melody's hands near chest, ears gently upright/inward and winglets relaxed. The trio is preparing together, warm content expressions. Tail tip in a low soft curve.

Pose01 / anticipation starts: Retto begins flexing both front elbows and rear knees without lifting any paw; chest/shoulders lower only slightly. Head/neck lower continuously with the chest, original skull size unchanged. Wings start folding backward at the elbows. Tato notices, turns its dot-eyed face up toward the wing, starts opening its hands; Melody tilts its head inward and raises both hands a little, ears lagging a little.

Pose02 / compressing: Retto chest/hips are slightly lower, front elbows visibly bent outward just a little, paws planted in original positions. Wings gather closer behind the shoulders, wrists tucking and primaries drawing together. Head follows chest down with a natural neck and pleased focused eyes. Tato leans a few degrees inward, hands open in front; Melody brings its hands toward chin and leans inward to watch, winglets partly raised.

Pose03 / late compression: Retto settles deeper through real leg flex, shoulder/head about4 percent of canvas height below neutral, face size unchanged. Wings folded compactly back with curved elbows and tucked outer fans. Tato's hands now ready near chest, looking at Retto's folded wing; Melody bends elbows near chest and slightly folds long ears backward, anticipating the breeze. No fear or worried face.

Pose04 / compressed anchor: Retto reaches a gentle seated crouch, shoulders/hips about5 percent of canvas height lower than neutral, ALL4 paws still supported at original floor. Head/jaw/neck/chest naturally connected, unchanged head and torso proportions; elbows/knees flex rather than squashing the cat. Wings gathered close behind back, wrists folded and long feather fans tucked/pointing diagonally back/down. Tato leans inward with both palms open at chest, small cheerful w mouth and dot eyes. Melody leans inward with both hands held near chest, winglets raised in readiness, friendly head tilt; ears/bow naturally attached.

Pose05 / push begins: Retto starts extending elbows and knees, shoulders rise slightly from crouch while paws remain grounded. Wings begin to unfold from the wrists, leading edges moving outward/upward, long primaries still trailing tucked behind. Head rises with neck/chest in one continuous anatomy. Tato and Melody both straighten a little, look at the opening wings, hands begin extending outward for balance.

Pose06 / rising/unfolding midpoint: Retto chest reaches almost neutral height, front legs extend naturally, all paws still down. Both wings open broadly outward and a little up, elbow/wrist anatomy clear with partly unfurled primary fans. Tato begins tilting outward to screen-left, both arms lifting away from torso; Melody begins tilting outward to screen-right with arms opening, ear tips/bow lagging inward from the new gust.

Pose07 / gust onset: Retto rises upright to neutral supported height, eyes warm and focused ahead, muzzle softly pleased. Wings spread almost fully sideways with shoulders fixed and long primaries splayed slightly; a strong but gentle down/out stroke is beginning. Tato leans outward8 degrees, opens both hands to catch balance and curls its thin tail toward Retto. Melody leans outward8 degrees, opens both arms and starts flapping winglets; long ears and bow ends trail from wind. Real articulated balance poses, not translated copies.

Pose08 / full gust anchor: Retto fully upright with chest proudly open, all4 paws firmly grounded, original face/body size. Main wings at broad downstroke, inner wings extended outward, wrists slightly cupped and primary feathers individually splayed/trailing. Broad wing span stays inside margins and behind pets. Retto's expression is warmly delighted, small open blue-grey eyes and natural closed-mouth feline smile. Tato is displaced only slightly outward (up to3 percent canvas width), torso leaning outward10 degrees, both hands extended and elbows flexed, tail curled inward; dot eyes and pleased w mouth or happy^^ eyes. Melody similarly moves slightly outward on its own side, leans outward10 degrees, both hands open for balance, little winglets actively spread, long ears/bow lag toward Retto. Both have coordinated cheerful reactions to Retto's same gust.

Pose09 / downstroke follow-through: Retto maintains upright supported torso, wings sweep slightly downward and curve at wrists, primaries trailing naturally after stroke, not growing/shrinking. Tato and Melody each reach their outward lean peak12 degrees but remain near the original scene positions, hands spread in a clear balancing gesture; Tato smiling with^^ eyes, Melody's face remains friendly and rectangular-eyed, winglets adjusting to stabilize. Ears/bow/tail lag then start recovering.

Pose10 / wind eases: Retto lowers wings toward relaxed half-open level, bends elbows minimally to settle, eyes look toward left Tato through a coherent whole head/neck/shoulder pose. All main paws remain planted. Tato starts pulling both hands inward and curling torso upright, thin tail counterbalancing; Melody gives a small inward-directed winglet flap and brings one hand toward Retto, beginning to approach back. Body sizes remain unchanged.

Pose11 / check left pet: Retto turns whole head/neck a gentle7 degrees toward Tato, shoulder response continuous, body relaxed upright and4 paws grounded. Wings recovering upward with folded wrists and trailing feather tips, not repeating the large gust. Tato leans inward toward Retto, reaches its inward hand toward Retto's grounded foreleg/side and lifts the other hand in a pleased greeting, dot or^^ eyes. Melody also starts leaning inward, one hand extended toward Retto and winglets recovering; ears/bow settle.

Pose12 / check right pet: Retto smoothly turns whole head/jaw/neck through centre toward right Melody by only5 degrees, shoulders/chest naturally follow, face size steady,4 paws grounded. Wings nearly back to relaxed half-open shape. Tato has returned close to its original left position, both hands relaxing near chest and gaze following Retto. Melody reaches its inward hand toward Retto's side with a pleased slight inward tilt, winglets gently folded from the returning flap, long ears starting upright again.

Pose13 / content recovery blink: Retto brings whole head/neck almost front, softly closes both eyes in a HAPPY relaxed blink, natural curved lids and no angry brows, closed feline mouth slightly upturned; chest eases into a slow exhale. All main paws supported and wings relaxed half-open. Tato lowers hands toward belly with a small satisfied head tilt; Melody retracts hand to chest and straightens, ears and ribbon still finishing a gentle settle.

Pose14 / reopen/settle intermediate: Retto's small eyes reopen about60 percent with visible blue-grey iris slivers and warm content expression, head/neck nearly starting neutral, chest settling. All4 paws fixed and main wings just before the initial relaxed position; tail tip finishes soft counterbalance. Tato and Melody are at their starting positions with hands nearly relaxed, ear/tail/bow movements damped naturally; no static whole-scene bob.

Pose15 / loop bridge: Retto small blue-grey eyes fully reopened, head/neck/chest and supported seated body smoothly approaching Pose00, wings within a small feather-tip movement of starting half-open shape, tail almost initial low curve. Tato hands lowered near belly and dot eyes looking toward Retto; Melody hands at chest, ears gently upright/inward and winglets relaxed, bow ends nearly settled. Make the final-to-first difference small and anatomically continuous, with no scale/camera/foot jump.
